items.title: ARCB or JBHT: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
items.summary: ArcBest (ARCB) is identified as the superior value option compared to JB Hunt (JBHT) in the transportation-truck sector. ARCB has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) with improving earnings outlook, a lower forward P/E ratio of 18.21 versus JBHT's 29.82, and a Value grade of B compared to JBHT's D grade. ARCB's PEG ratio of 0.39 and P/B ratio of 2.24 also indicate better valuation metrics than JBHT's 1.82 and 5.81 respectively.

items.title: J.B. Hunt Investor News: If You Have Suffered Losses in J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc., You Are Encouraged to Contact The Rosen Law Firm About Your Rights
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm is investigating potential securities claims against J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc. after the company issued a warning that third-quarter earnings would fall due to increased costs for recruiting, advertising, onboarding, training, and sign-on bonuses (approximately $25 million more than Q2). The stock plunged 10% on September 16, 2026, following the announcement. Investors who purchased J.B. Hunt securities may be eligible to join a class action lawsuit seeking compensation.
